title: Bug: Valid DAE fails to open correctly

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: Global flag to mark a deviation from expected behaviour

labels.name: Collada
labels.description: Bugs related to the Collada format.

body:
**Describe the bug**

A valid DAE opens incorectly with assimp

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1.  [cr-c75u2-close-combat.tar.gz](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12644918/cr-c75u2-close-combat.tar.gz)
2. Import the file with assimp
3. Resulting loaded data is incoherent and changes at every load, basically I'm recovering uninitialized data

A few results I got:

![a](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/assets/3129530/d10de073-fc93-4b2b-8b96-ed73d627dc2f)

![a](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/assets/3129530/c008ba20-a822-42b6-bba0-831943e3cd01)


**Expected behavior**

Importing in blender:

![a](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/assets/3129530/95721bbd-4a49-42bc-af40-2b5c56fed904)

**Additional context**

 - Tested with F3D and MadViews
 - Another dataset with the same behavior:  [models-exports.tar.gz](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/12644942/models-exports.tar.gz)
 - Both models were exported from LeoCad: https://github.com/leozide/leocad
 - Sister F3D issue: https://github.com/f3d-app/f3d/issues/1000
- Sister leocad issue: https://github.com/leozide/leocad/issues/797

At this point I consider this issue to be coming from assimp, not F3D or LeoCad.
